system.description:
To prevent capture and analysis, the Droid comes equipped with a powerful explosive. The charge destroys the Droid from within (no attack required), and a Droid destroyed in this fashion cannot be repaired or salvaged.

The explosive is treated as an Area Attack (+5 attack bonus). The damage to all targets with the area is determined by the Droid's size (see below), and the Burst radius of the explosion is 2 squares per 4d6 points of damage (minimum 2 squares).

Droids of Tiny size and smaller do not deal collateral damage when they self-destruct.

DROID SIZE DAMAGE
Small 4d6
Medium 6d6
Large 8d6
Huge 10d6
Gargantuan or Larger 20d6
